title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: SEATS/GRA-MAG (1,770 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH SEATS BUILT BY GRA-MAG, THE SEAT PIVOT BOLTS CAN LOOSEN AND POSSIBLY FRACTURE OR DISLODGE, CAUSING THE SEAT BACK TO FAIL TO PROVIDE FULL SUPPORT TO THE DRIVER'S BACK.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): SIDE AIR BAG CURTAIN (1,142 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN PICKUP TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH THE OPTIONAL SIDE CURTAIN AIR BAG, THE CURTAIN FASTENERS MAY NOT HAVE BEEN PROPERLY TIGHTENED.

title: Triumph Motorcycles America, Ltd.: OIL SEAL (1,994 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MOTORCYCLES, DAMAGE TO THE OIL SEAL OCCURRED DURING FINAL ASSEMBLY.   ONCE DAMAGED SOME OF THE OIL IN THE DRIVE UNIT COULD ESCAPE PAST THE SEAL.

title: General Motors, LLC: FRACTURE POWER STEERING PUMP DRIVESHAFT (98,221 affected)
summary: SOME PICKUP TRUCKS, VANS, AND SPORT UTILITY VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH A HYDRAULIC PUMP DRIVESHAFT THAT CAN FRACTURE, RESULTING IN IMMEDIATE LOSS OF HYDRAULIC POWER STEERING ASSIST.  ON CERTAIN VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH HYDRO-BOOST POWER BRAKES, THE SAME CONDITION CAN RESULT IN LOSS OF POWER ASSIST FOR BRAKING AFTER THE RESERVE PRESSURE IS DEPLETED.

title: Crossroads RV: FURNACE EXHAUST VENT (5,890 affected)
summary: CERTAIN TRAVEL AND FIFTH WHEEL TRAILERS HAVE IMPROPERLY INSTALLED FURNACE EXHAUST VENTS.

title: STARCRAFT BUS AND MOBILITY: FMVSS 217/EMERGENCY EXIT DOOR (612 affected)
summary: CERTAIN TRANSIT BUSES FAIL TO COMPLY WITH  THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 217, "BUS EMERGENCY EXITS AND WINDOW RETENTION AND RELEASE."  THE REAR DOOR IS NOT LABELED CORRECTLY TO IDENTIFY THAT IT IS AN EMERGENCY EXIT AND INSTRUCTIONS FOR OPENING THE DOOR ARE NOT AFFIXED TO THE DOOR.

title: Jayco, Inc.: BATTERY CABLE MELTING (688 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MOTOR HOMES THE BATTERY CABLE MAY HAVE BEEN ROUTED TOO CLOSE TO THE EXHAUST MANIFOLD.

title: Shyft Group: FRONT AXLE BRAKE INCORRECT ADJUSTMENT (490 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MOTOR HOMES, THE SLACK ADJUSTERS IN THE FRONT AXLES WERE NOT ADJUSTED PROPERLY.

title: EATON HYDRAULICS DIVISION: EATON/POWER STEERING PUMP LEAKAGE (3,517 affected)
summary: CERTAIN EATON POWER STEERING PUMPS, MODEL VTM42, WHICH EATON MANUFACTURED AND ASSEMBLED FOR USE ON CERTAIN HEAVY DUTY VEHICLES.  DUE TO AN INCOMPLETE SEAL ON A PORT PLUG ON THE PUMP, LEAKAGE OF THE HYDRAULIC FLUID CAN OCCUR WHICH COULD RESULT IN A REDUCTION IN THE POWER ASSIST.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: FUEL INLET HOSE ASSEMBLY (13,173 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN HEAVY DUTY CLASS 8 DIESEL TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH ASET AC ENGINES, THE LOCATION OF THE FUEL INLET HOSE MAY RESULT IN OVERHEATING OR ABRASION OF THE HOSE, WHICH MAY LEAD TO A PREMATURE FAILURE.

title: Komfort Corporation: ALUMINUM RIMS (18 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN FIFTH WHEEL TRAILERS EQUIPPED WITH ALUMINUM WHEELS, THE THICKNESS OF THE WHEEL MAY NOT ALLOW FOR ENOUGH THREAD ENGAGEMENT OF THE LUG NUTS.

title: Kia America, Inc.: THROTTLE CABLE (89,238 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MINI VANS, DURING ASSEMBLY, THE THROTTLE CABLE WOULD TWIST ITSELF OUT OF POSITION.

title: General Motors, LLC: FRONTAL AND ROOF RAIL AIR BAGS (87,000 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES, AN INTERACTION BETWEEN THE SENSING AND DIAGNOSTIC MODULE AND VEHICLE'S ELECTRICAL SYSTEM MAY CAUSE THE DRIVER'S FRONTAL AIR BAG AND/OR ROOF-MOUNTED SIDE IMPACT AIR BAG TO DEPLOY WHEN THE IGNITION KEY IS TURNED TO THE "ON" POSITION.

title: Collins Bus Corporation: FUEL LEAKS (108 affected)
summary: CERTAIN 2002 THRU 2005 COLLINS BANTAM AND SUPER BANTAM SCHOOL BUSES MANUFACTURED BETWEEN SEPTEMBER 18, 2002, AND JANUARY 17, 2005.  THE PROTECTIVE RUBBER PARTS THAT COVER THE FUEL LINES TO PREVENT CONTACT WITH METAL EDGES MAY BE MISSING.

title: General Motors, LLC: STEERING SHAFT GEAR FRACTURE (3,344 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN TRUCKS, THE BOLT THAT ATTACHES THE INTERMEDIATE STEERING SHAFT TO THE STEERING GEAR MAY NOT MEET SPECIFICATION.  THE BOLT MAY FRACTURE RESULTING IN THE LOSS OF STEERING.

title: Eldorado National- California, Inc.: DEFECTIVE BALL SOCKET/ARVIN-MERITOR/TRW (80 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN TRANSIT BUSES EQUIPPED WITH ARVIN-MERITOR AND TRW 20-EDL BALL SOCKET ASSEMBLIES HAVE A LESS ROBUST BEARING DESIGN, WHICH LEADS TO HIGHER WEAR RATES AND MORE RAPID WEAR-OUT THAN PREVIOUS DESIGNS.

title: ALFA LEISURE,INC.: REFRIGERATOR LPG LINES (88 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MOTOR HOMES, A PLASTIC FITTING USED TO TEST THE REFRIGERATOR'S LIQUID PROPANE GAS (LPG) SYSTEM WAS NOT REMOVED AND REPLACED WITH A BRASS FITTING.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): MOTORCYCLES/COMBINED BRAKE SYSTEM LEAK (36,046 affected)
summary: CERTAIN MOTORCYCLES EQUIPPED WITH COMBINED-BRAKE SYSTEMS HAVE A PROPORTIONING CONTROL VALVE (PCV) THAT MECHANICALLY PROPORTIONS BRAKE FORCE WHEN THE REAR BRAKE IS APPLIED.  A SEAL IN SOME PCVS IS IMPROPERLY SHAPED, AND BRAKE FLUID LEAKAGE MAY OCCUR.

title: GIRARDIN MINIBUS INC.: OPTIONAL BATTERY BOX SHORT CIRCUIT/FIRE (121 affected)
summary: CERTAIN GIRARDIN MINIBUS MY 2004 AND 2005 MB II AND MBIV FORD DIESEL SCHOOL BUSES EQUIPPED WITH OPTIONAL BBX (BATTERY BOX) MANUFACTURED BETWEEN MAY 14, 2004 AND FEBRUARY 9, 2005.  THE ELECTRICAL CABLES (P/NOS. 27DF01 AND 27DF3001) BETWEEN THE BATTERIES AND THE BATTERY JUNCTION BOX (UNDER THE HOOD) HAS NO FUSABLE LINK FOR CABLE PROTECTION.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: FMVSS 217/EMERGENCY EXIT WINDOWS/HEHR (59 affected)
summary: CERTAIN TRANSIT BUSES FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 217, "BUS EMERGENCY EXITS AND WINDOW RETENTION AND RELEASE."  THE STRIKER PLATES AT THE BOTTOM OF THE EMERGENCY PUSHOUT WINDOWS CAN WEAR A GROOVE INTO THE EMERGENCY RELEASE BOLT.  IF THIS GROOVE BECOMES DEEP ENOUGH, THE EMERGENCY PUSH WINDOW MAY FAIL TO OPEN AS INTENDED WHEN RELEASED.

title: Maserati North America, Inc.: NON-FUNCTIONING AIR BAG SWITCH (495 affected)
summary: CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES HAVE A NON-FUNCTIONING BUTTON WITH THE WORDS  "PASSENGER AIR BAG OFF" ETCHED INTO IT.  THIS BUTTON IS LOCATED, ALONG WITH AN LED LIGHT, ON A CONSOLE ADJACENT TO THE SUN ROOF.  THIS NON-FUNCTIONING BUTTON DOES NOT DEACTIVATE THE PASSENGER-SIDE AIR BAG, NOR IS THE LED LIGHT AN INDICATION THAT THE PASSENGER SIDE AIR BAG HAS BEEN DEACTIVATED.  THE BUTTON IS NON-FUNCTIONAL AND CANNOT BE DEPRESSED WHEN PUSHED.

title: Ferrari North America, Inc.: NON-FUNCTIONING AIR BAG SWITCH (110 affected)
summary: CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES HAVE A NON-FUNCTIONING BUTTON WITH THE WORDS "PASSENGER AIR BAG OFF" ETCHED INTO IT.  THIS BUTTON IS LOCATED, ALONG WITH AN LED LIGHT, ON A CONSOLE ADJACENT TO THE SUN ROOF.  THIS NON-FUNCTIONING BUTTON DOES NOT DEACTIVATE THE PASSENGER -SIDE AIR BAG, NOR IS THE LED LIGHT AN INDICATION THAT THE PASSENGER SIDE AIR BAG HAS BEEN DEACTIVATED.  THE BUTTON IS NON-FUNCTIONAL AND CANNOT BE DEPRESSED WHEN PUSHED.

title: YOUR TRUCK SHOP, INC.: YOUR TRUCK SHOP/FMVSS 108/REAR TAIL LAMPS (300 affected)
summary: 4 INCH AFTERMARKET TAIL LIGHTS, MODEL TLED 4CR.  THESE LIGHTS DO NOT MEET THE PHOTOMETRIC REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 108, LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES, AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT.

title: Continental Tire the Americas, LLC: CONTINENTAL/POSSIBLE TIRE FAILURE (143 affected)
summary: A VARIETY OF CONTINENTAL, TOYO, GENERAL, AND YOKOHAMA TIRES WHICH THE RUBBER COMPOUND USED IN THE SHOULDER PAD COMPONENT OF THE TIRE IS NOT THE SPECIFIED RUBBER COMPOUND AS DETAILED IN THE TIRE SPECIFICATION.

title: Ford Motor Company: SPEED CONTROL DEACTIVATION SWITCH FIRES (738,490 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN SPORT UTILITY VEHICLES AND PICKUP TRUCKS, THE SPEED CONTROL DEACTIVATION SWITCH MAY OVERHEAT, SMOKE, OR BURN.

title: Suzuki Motor USA, LLC: STOP LAMP SWITCH (37,796 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES, THE BRAKE LIGHT SWITCH MAY BECOME MISADJUSTED IF AN UPWARD/REARWARD FORCE IS APPLIED TO THE BRAKE PEDAL.  IF THIS SHOULD OCCUR, THE BRAKE LIGHT SWITCH WILL NOT FUNCTION PROPERLY, CAUSING THE BRAKE LIGHTS, INCLUDING THE HIGH MOUNTED STOP LAMP, TO REMAIN ILLUMINATED CONTINUOUSLY WITHOUT BRAKE PEDAL APPLICATION, WITH THE IGNITION SWITCH IN THE ON OR OFF POSITION.

title: Jayco, Inc.: 120-VOLT POWER NO CIRCUIT PROTECTION DEVICE (32 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN MOTOR HOMES, THE 120-VOLT SHORE POWER CORD WAS WIRED WITHOUT A CIRCUIT PROTECTION DEVICE.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): IGNITION-PARK INTERLOCK (486,659 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN PASSENGER VEHICLES, THE INTERLOCK OPERATION OF THE IGNITION SWITCH MAY NOT FUNCTION PROPERLY, MAKING IT POSSIBLE TO TURN THE IGNITION KEY TO THE "OFF" POSITION AND REMOVE THE KEY WITHOUT SHIFTING THE TRANSMISSION TO PARK.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): MOTORCYCLE/FRAME CRACKS (34,919 affected)
summary: ON SOME MOTORCYCLES, CERTAIN FRAME WELDS DO NOT MEET MANUFACTURING SPECIFICATIONS.  HIGH LOADS CREATED WHEN RIDING ON ROUGH ROAD SURFACES OR THROUGH POTHOLES CAN CAUSE THE AFFECTED WELDS TO CRACK.

summary: A tsunami on 2005-01-19 after an M6.6 earthquake, from NOAA NCEI's global historical tsunami database.

title: CPSC, Norco Products Ltd. Announce Recall of Bicycle Attachment
summary: The hardware used in the assembly of the universal hitch may come loose, causing the unit to separate from the lead bicycle, which could lead to a serious injury or death to the rider of the bicycle attachment. Units: About 80,000.

title: CPSC, Orbelle Trade Inc. Announce Recall of Cribs
summary: The Amber model crib included in this recall does not comply with crib safety standards due to a gap between the side rail and the crib mattress support, posing an entrapment hazard to infants. All other model cribs included in this recall do not have proper assembly instructions and diagrams requir

title: CPSC, Royal Appliance Announce Recall of Sweeper Vac™
summary: The vacuum's rotor can lock and overheat during use, causing a smoke and fire hazard. Units: About 20,000.

title: CPSC, The Step 2 Co. Announce Recall to Repair Toddler Swings
summary: The straps on these swings could break, causing a child riding in the swing to fall to the ground and suffer injuries. Units: About 9,300.

title: CPSC, Carlton Cards Retails, Inc. Announce Recall of Tealight Candle Holder
summary: During normal use, the decorative marshmallows or decorative campfire flames may catch fire. Units: About 5,000.

title: CPSC, Kids Station Inc. Announce Recall of Children's Musical Drum Set Sold Exclusively at Toys "R" Us
summary: Small parts can break off during use, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 10,500.

title: CPSC, Martha Stewart Living Omnimedia, Inc. Announce Recall of Full Moon Lantern
summary: The lantern can overheat and melt or ignite, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,700 sets (2 lanterns per set).

title: CPSC, Philips PC Peripherals Announce Recall of Hewlett-Packard Company L2035 Flat Panel Monitors
summary: A ground clip inside the back plastic panel of these monitors can be incorrectly installed, posing a risk of electrical shock to consumers. Units: About 15,000.

title: CPSC, Selle Royal/fi'zi:k Announce Recall of Bicycle Seats
summary: The plastic scuff guard underneath the front of the seat, which secures the seat rails, may crack or break, causing the rider to lose control and/or fall, resulting in a serious injury. Units: About 257.

title: CPSC, Climb High Inc. Announce Recall of Avalanche Transceivers
summary: The transceiver's plastic casing could crack, causing a malfunction, if water were to enter the unit. If the transceiver fails to function properly in the aftermath of an avalanche, it could result in the buried victim not being found in time to avoid serious injury or death. Units: About 137.

title: CPSC, Club Car Inc. Announce Recall to Repair DS Golf Cars, Hospitality, Utility & Transport Vehicles and Rough Terrain Vehicles
summary: Microscopic cracks in the brake equalizer rods on certain vehicles may cause the rods to fatigue and fail prematurely in continuous use. Such failure could result in a loss of braking ability. Units: 19,663.

title: CPSC, Emerson Tool Co. Announce Recall to Repair Wet/Dry Vacuums
summary: The air intake shield may be missing. Consumers can suffer lacerations if they come into contact with the intake blower wheel. Units: About 6,500.

title: CPSC, Flow International Announce Recall of Snowboard Bindings
summary: The pin used to secure the rear snaplock lever to the bindings can bend or break. Units: About 6,000.

title: CPSC, Poundex Associates Corp. Announce Recall of Dining Chairs
summary: The welds on the chair's rear legs can crack and break apart, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 32,000.

title: CPSC, Sauder Woodworking Co. Announce Recall of Mini Spot-light Bulbs in Furniture Hutches Sold At Office Depot Stores
summary: Some of the bulbs have imploded or broken apart within the first several minutes after they are first illuminated. Broken glass particles pose a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 22,600.

title: CPSC, Wal-Mart Stores, Inc. Announce Recall of Slow Cookers
summary: The handles on the base of the slow cookers can break, posing a risk of burns from hot food spilling onto consumers. Units: 600,000.

title: CPSC, Riviera Trading Inc. Announce Recall of Children's Costume Bracelets
summary: The bracelets contain high levels of lead and pose a lead poisoning hazard to children. Units: About 7,100.

title: CPSC, SHURflo Announce Recall to Repair Backpack Sprayers
summary: The power plug can corrode after extensive exposure to water and corrosive chemicals, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 6,100.

title: CPSC, Leiner Health Products Announce Recall of Multivitamins
summary: The vitamins, which contain iron that can cause serious injury or death if ingested by children, do not have child-resistant packaging, as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. Units: About 13,000.

title: CPSC, Commend Co. Ltd. Announce Recall of Dining Set Chairs
summary: The wooden chairs can break, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 600.

title: CPSC, Lakewood Announce Recall of Oil-Filled Electric Heaters
summary: Welds can rupture, expelling hot oil, that can burn nearby consumers. Units: 70,000.

title: CPSC, Polk Audio Announce Recall of LSiW Powered Subwoofers
summary: Electrical components in the subwoofer can overheat and fail, resulting in electrical arcing and smoke. Units: About 670.

title: CPSC, Jumpking Inc.® Announce Recall of Trampolines, Enclosures
summary: Welds on the frame of these trampolines can break during use, resulting in falls and possible injuries. Additionally, the mounting brackets of the FunRing enclosures have sharp edges, which can cause lacerations. Units: About 1 million trampolines and about 296,000 "FunRing" enclosures.

title: CPSC, Pottery Barn Kids Announce Recall of Chamois Blankets
summary: The decorative stitching on the blanket's edge can come loose, allowing a child to become entangled in the yarn. This poses a strangulation hazard to young children. Units: About 92,000.

title: CPSC, Research Products Corp. Announce Recall of Electronic Air Cleaners
summary: The air cleaner's plastic inner housing and filter are not flame-resistant. If electrical arcing occurs in the cleaner, a fire can develop. This poses a risk of burn injuries and property damage. Units: About 67,000.
